# ARFID Outcomes

> Therapeutic audio sessions that help children overcome ARFID (Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder) through Cognitive Pattern Reprogramming — a combination of CBT principles and strategic hypnotherapy delivered as short, calming audio tracks.

## What this site offers

- **Product:** Full Access Membership — $29.95/month, cancel anytime
- **Sign up:** https://app.mindshift.studio/trial/arid
- **Library:** 300+ therapeutic audio sessions, new tracks added monthly
- **Core program:** ARFID modules for Sensory Sensitivity, Fear of Aversive Consequences, and Low Appetite/Interest
- **Additional categories:** anxiety & worry, sleep & bedtime, confidence & self-esteem, emotional regulation, school & focus, screen-time habits, sibling harmony, and stress support for parents
- **Method:** Listening during relaxed states (bedtime, quiet time) builds new neural pathways — removing mental blocks rather than pressuring food
- **Audience:** Parents of children ages ~4–14 with ARFID or related challenges
- **Format:** Mobile-friendly streaming, most sessions under 10 minutes

## Important disclaimers

- Educational audio content, NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment
- Designed to complement (not replace) professional care for eating disorders
- Always consult a physician or qualified mental health provider about ARFID
